subject.title: fix(channels): centralize access gates and media fallback

question: Should `sendPayloadTextChunkSequence` become a durable public Plugin SDK contract despite currently having only the QQBot production consumer?
rationale: The supplemental sender gate has broad cross-plugin use, while the text sequencer does not yet meet the repository's high bar for expanding permanent third-party API surface.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep the supplemental sender helper public, move the text sequencer to QQBot-local code, and reduce the surface budget addition accordingly.

options.title: Approve both public helpers
options.body: Explicitly accept both helpers as supported third-party contracts and require live behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Narrow the public surface
recommendation.body: Keep the supplemental sender helper public, move the text sequencer to QQBot-local code, and reduce the surface budget addition accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: They have prior current-main history on the Plugin SDK media fallback contract and are the current assignee for this cross-channel refactor.
